title: Human Islet Cryopreservation Protocol
author: James Lyon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bt6cnraw
materials: Brady™ FREEZERBONDZ™ Polyester Thermal Transfer Labels

steps.title: Prepare M199 base media
steps.instruction: Dispense 9 L of Milli‑Q water (18 MΩ) into a carboy, store overnight at 4 °C, add M199 powder (9.41 g · L⁻¹, Mediatech‑Cornell 90050PB) and stir for 30 min; add NaHCO₃ (22.0 g for 26 mM, Fisher S233‑500), HEPES (23.83 g for 10 mM, Fisher BP310‑1), and Penicillin/Streptomycin (50 mL, 20 000 U · mL⁻¹ penicillin & 20 000 µg · mL⁻¹ streptomycin, Lonza 09‑757F), stir another 30 min, store overnight at 4 °C, stir 30 min again, calibrate pH meter with control buffers, adjust pH to 7.4 with NaOH/HCl, bring volume to 10 L with Milli‑Q water, and filter into 1 L bottles using a 0.22 µm nitrocellulose filter.

steps.title: Pre‑cool FTS bath
steps.instruction: Set the FTS bath temperature to –7.4 °C and allow it to equilibrate for approximately 2 hours before starting the cryopreservation procedure.

steps.title: Label cryopreservation tubes
steps.instruction: Print Brady™ FREEZERBONDZ™ polyester thermal transfer labels (Fisher Cat #22‑500521) and affix to each tube, recording internal ID (Rxxx), islet equivalents (IEQ) per tube, cryoprotectant (DMSO), cryopreservation date, and tube number.

steps.title: Aliquot islets into tubes
steps.instruction: Dispense human islets into the labeled tubes, not exceeding 25 000 IEQ per tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge all tubes at 280 × g, 4 °C for 1 min, then carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add freeze M199 suspension
steps.instruction: At room temperature (22 °C), add 1 mL of freeze M199 to each tube and gently resuspend the islets.

steps.title: Add initial 2 M DMSO
steps.instruction: At room temperature (22 °C), add 500 µL of 2 M DMSO to each tube and start a timer (time = 0 min).

steps.title: Add second 2 M DMSO
steps.instruction: At 5 min, add an additional 500 µL of 2 M DMSO to each tube.

steps.title: Add 3 M DMSO
steps.instruction: At 30 min, add 2 mL of 3 M DMSO to each tube.

steps.title: Transfer to ice bath
steps.instruction: At 45 min, move all tubes to a rack placed in an ice bath (0 °C).

steps.title: Transfer to seeding bath
steps.instruction: At 55 min, transfer the tubes to the pre‑chilled FTS seeding bath set at –7.5 °C.

steps.title: Nucleate tubes
steps.instruction: At 65 min, nucleate each tube by submerging it in liquid nitrogen for 2 s, then firmly striking the tube against a solid object to induce slush formation; immediately return the tube to the –7.5 °C seeding bath.

steps.title: Begin controlled cooling
steps.instruction: At 85 min, start the FTS bath cooling program at a rate of 2.5 °C · min⁻¹ from –7.5 °C.

steps.title: Cool to –40 °C
steps.instruction: Continue the programmed cooling until the bath reaches –40 °C, then promptly transfer all tubes to liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Store in LN₂ vapor phase
steps.instruction: After transfer to liquid nitrogen (–190 °C), move the tubes to long‑term storage in a liquid‑nitrogen vapor‑phase tank (e.g., Chart MVE 1500 Series or equivalent).

steps.title: Prepare freeze M199 solution
steps.instruction: Combine 100 mL heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum (HyClone, Fisher cat #SH3039603) with 900 mL M199 media; store at 4 °C and warm to room temperature before use.

substeps.instruction: Thaw serum, aliquot into labeled 50 mL tubes.
If thawed in a refrigerator, allow serum to reach room temperature before water‑bath treatment.
Fill a water bath with enough water to submerge the tubes to the serum level, set to 56 °C, and incubate for 30 min.
Remove tubes from the water bath and store heat‑inactivated FBS at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 3 M DMSO solution
steps.instruction: Add DMSO (Fisher cat #BP231) to freeze M199 to a final amount of 11.7 g, bringing the total volume to 50 mL; filter‑sterilize through a 0.2 µm nylon syringe filter into a sterile glass bottle, store at 4 °C, and warm to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare 2 M DMSO solution
steps.instruction: Add DMSO (Fisher cat #BP231) to freeze M199 to a final amount of 7.8 g, bringing the total volume to 50 mL; filter‑sterilize through a 0.2 µm nylon syringe filter into a sterile glass bottle, store at 4 °C, and warm to room temperature before use.
